digest.component_or_area: external live Jira DC test harness
propositions: A fake transport cannot reach real cross-project isolation failure modes that appear against live Jira (real JQL over multiple projects, per-project key allocation, cross-project contamination).

Non-existent project keys in Jira cause parse errors and abort the entire pass when queried without per-project exception handling, but the fake transport returned empty results masking this behavior.
The live-Cloud rehearsal requires more isolated throwaway projects than two shared production projects supply to model three repo shapes, empty projects, and unknown-project fail-closed paths.

The rehearsal must provision scratch projects with hardened template verification, run every mutating scenario through preview-gating to assert no cross-project contamination, and delete all projects on every exit path.
A configured but mapped-but-absent project key must fail-closed (pass errors and writes nothing), while a real empty project returns empty results and is tolerated.

Multiple real failure modes and test-precondition bugs were discovered in live DC runs, including unresolved ticket aliases in selection, promote-only guards firing before sync, and uncommitted project mappings.
